name: Thai Chicken Tacos with Sesame-Ginger Cucumber & Cabbage Salad

instructions.primary_message: Place curry paste, oil, and fish sauce in a medium bowl. Whisk to combine the marinade.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp Thai curry paste, red
1 tbsp toasted sesame oil
1 tbsp fish sauce

instructions.primary_message: Slice chicken into ½-inch thick strips. Add to the bowl with the marinade, stir to coat, and set aside for 10 minutes.
When the chicken is done marinating, preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches if necessary, add chicken strips and marinade; cook, stirring occasionally, until cooked through, 5-6 minutes. Remove to a plate.
Meanwhile, place dressing and miso paste in a large bowl. Whisk to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ cup sesame ginger dressing
3 tbsp miso paste, white

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry cucumbers; using a clean cutting board, trim and small dice. Add to the bowl with the dressing along with the shredded cabbage. Stir to combine the salad and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ English cucumbers
1 ½ (397 g) bags shredded cabbage (coleslaw mix)

instructions.primary_message: Wash, dry, and cut limes into wedges; set aside for serving.
Warm taco shells in the microwave if desired.
Divide taco shells between plates, then fill with a small portion of the salad and chicken. Serve with remaining salad and lime wedges for squeezing. Enjoy!
